title: First release
body: Dynamic Stats is here. Live analytics from YouTube, App Store Connect, Hacker News and GitHub, right in your Dynamic Island.
bullets: YouTube: views, likes and comments, updated every 5 minutes from the moment you publish
App Store Connect: downloads, proceeds, purchases and review status
Hacker News: rank, points and comments on any post
GitHub: stars, forks and release downloads
Lock Screen Live Activity with sparkline
StandBy, Apple Watch and Mac menu bar support
